title: Stranger Things: The First Shadow
wpTitle: Stranger Things: The Experience Reviews at the Troubadour Brent Cross Studios

ratings.excerpt: After a wonky start, this official immersive show does a decent job of throwing you into the world of the Netflix smash … If you’ve never seen or actively dislike ‘Stranger Things’, it would be pretty perverse of you to hike out to Brent Cross for this. But if you like the show – even relatively casually – then ‘Stranger Things: The Experience’ is a very fun hour of fan service. It has a glacial start to be sure, but the Netflix megabucks win out in the end. If the end of Season Four has left you feeling bereft, this is the place to go to get yourself that little extra bump of strangeness.

Ups and downs in the Upside-Down … Some genuinely creepy moments in the immersive show were undermined by the lack of sound-proofing in the building … Featuring an all-new (presumably non-canon) storyline, the audience plays a group of townspeople who have been selected to participate in a special “sleep study … A cynical cash grab from Netflix, or simply a price worth paying for a unique experience? I suspect that will depend on how much of a fan you are. Did I enjoy it? Yes. Would I pay for it? Probably not.
